title: Bạn có thể giúp tôi liên hệ với đại sứ quán được không?
englishTitle: Can you help me contact the embassy?
pronunciation: Ban co the giup toi lien he voi dai su quan duoc khong
summary: For asking a hotel desk, clinic, police counter, or trusted helper to help contact your embassy.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use it when the next step needs an official contact, not just a local suggestion.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show your passport copy, embassy number, contact page, or message draft. Keep the request calm and direct.

phrases.english: Can you help me contact the embassy?

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Bạn có thể asks can you; giúp tôi means help me; liên hệ với đại sứ quán means contact the embassy; được không softens the request.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Lost and left-something cards cover the story that may explain why embassy help is needed.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at hotels, clinics, police counters, travel offices, and with a trusted local helper during a serious document or safety problem.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Embassy help usually needs exact identity and contact details. Keep your passport copy or phone screen ready.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Move to need-help, call-hotel, manager, charged-twice, or file-report cards if the helper asks what happened next.
